rounds.text:
I don't have current suite rates or promotions, so I can't promise a deal. The front desk can tell you about any weekend offers and confirm availability.

If you book for this weekend, you'd already be inside our 48-hour cancellation window. Cancelling after booking would cost one night's rate.

I can set up a suite booking with your dates so the desk can quote you a price. Just tell me your check-in and check-out dates. Your 5pm harbor cruise booking is still open whenever you want to finish it.
